name: kirc_kidney_glioma_directional_lineage_driver_genes
license: N/A - hand-curated gene-lineage membership derived from published cancer-genetics literature (WHO CNS5 IDH-based glioma classification; WHO renal tumor classification VHL/ccRCC and MET/papillary-RCC driver associations); not extracted from a single licensed dataset file.
source: Manually curated from independent cancer-genetics literature, split by molecular-subtype direction instead of by single anatomic/organ group (unlike knowledge/kirc_kidney_glioma_lineage_v1.json, which pooled each organ's drivers into one undirected group). Four fixed gene lists: (1) kirc_lineage (VHL, MTOR) - defining/associated ccRCC(KIRC) driver genes on the VHL-HIF-mTOR axis; (2) kipan_nonccrcc_lineage (TSC1, TSC2, MET) - drivers associated with non-clear-cell renal tumors that fall inside the heterogeneous KIPAN superclass (papillary RCC's defining MET driver; TSC1/TSC2-associated non-ccRCC renal tumors); (3) lgg_idh_lineage (IDH1, IDH2, ATRX, TP53) - WHO CNS5 IDH-mutant astrocytoma co-mutation signature; (4) gbm_idh_wildtype_lineage (NF1, PTEN, EGFR) - WHO CNS5 / cIMPACT-NOW IDH-wildtype GBM molecular signature (EGFR amplification/mutation, PTEN loss, NF1 loss). Gene-to-group assignment is fixed from this independent literature, not from this competition's per-class mutation frequencies, SUBCLASS labels, or Public LB.
source_url: N/A: hand-curated literature gene panel; no single downloadable source file or repository commit to cite (same provenance pattern as knowledge/kirc_kidney_glioma_lineage_v1.json).
extraction_policy: Same 14 driver genes as knowledge/kirc_kidney_glioma_lineage_v1.json's two pooled groups (VHL, MTOR, TSC1, TSC2, MET from the former kidney_vhl_mtor group minus PTEN and FH; IDH1, IDH2, ATRX, TP53, NF1, PTEN, EGFR from the former glioma_who_idh group), re-split into four directionally consistent groups instead of two pooled groups. PTEN was removed from the kidney groups: EXP-603's train.csv verification found KIPAN 0.0369 vs KIRC 0.0359 mutation rate for PTEN in the kidney context (a 0.0010 gap), which is noise-level and does not support assigning PTEN to either kirc_lineage or kipan_nonccrcc_lineage; PTEN is retained only in gbm_idh_wildtype_lineage, where its GBMLGG-favoring direction (0.1627 vs 0.0349, +0.128) is unambiguous and consistent with its WHO CNS5 role. FH was removed entirely: EXP-603's train.csv verification found zero mutated samples for FH in both KIPAN and KIRC (zero-variance in this dataset), so it carries no information and was excluded from every group rather than assigned to one. All four groups are non-overlapping (no gene appears in more than one group), unlike the pooled predecessor file where PTEN was intentionally shared.
selection_policy: Fixed before this experiment's OOF run. Group membership is grounded in independent published cancer-genetics literature: WHO CNS5 classifies IDH-mutant astrocytoma by IDH1/IDH2/ATRX/TP53 co-mutation and IDH-wildtype GBM by EGFR amplification/mutation, PTEN loss, and (per one of the three cIMPACT-NOW diagnostic criteria) NF1 loss/mutation; WHO renal tumor classification treats VHL as the defining ccRCC(KIRC) driver and MET as the defining papillary RCC driver (a non-ccRCC KIPAN component), with TSC1/TSC2 associated with other non-clear-cell renal tumors. This experiment's data check of data/raw/train.csv per-class mutation rates (documented in reports/exp603_directional_lineage_burden/README.md) is used only to confirm this known biology is reflected in the competition data, not to pick or reassign genes to groups; no gene was moved between groups, added, or removed because of a train.csv rate that contradicted the literature-predicted direction. SUBCLASS distribution, fold assignment, validation, test data and Public LB were not used to define group membership.
organizer_approval_reference: https://github.com/fabxoe/open_cancer/issues/96#issuecomment-5151028180 (same fixed-external-gene-group-membership / competition-CSV-only-values pattern already covered by this comment for knowledge/canonical_pathways_sanchez_vega_v1.json and knowledge/kirc_kidney_glioma_lineage_v1.json; this knowledge file follows the identical pattern with the same 14-gene literature panel re-split into four directionally consistent groups).
